note: Questions for scripts/eval-inquiry.mjs. Each is run through the Falsify tools by a Copilot CLI agent, with and without the falsify-inquiry guidance, and scored from the recorded sessions, not from what the agent says about itself. Pairs are opposite framings of one topic; 'control' questions have settled answers, so a method that cannot reproduce them is suspect.

questions.question: Is the information in DNA best explained by an intelligent cause?
Is the information in DNA best explained by unguided natural processes?
Does the Cambrian explosion show that gradual Darwinian mechanisms cannot produce new body plans in the time available?
Does the fossil record of the Cambrian show that gradual common descent can account for new body plans?
Does exerting self-control on one task reduce performance on a later, unrelated self-control task?
Does cigarette smoking cause lung cancer?
Does the MMR vaccine cause autism?
Does moderate alcohol consumption lower all-cause mortality compared with abstaining?
